g.text: IF-1 / IF-7 Information Disclosure: Shor cracks ECDH X25519; enables HNDL session playback.

g.text: IF-4 Spoofing & Tampering: Shor factors RSA-2048 to forge pacs.008 settlement XMLs.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #881337

g.text: IF-8 Denial of Service: Oversized PQC keys (>1500 B) trigger MTU fragmentation & HSM stalls.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #881337

g.text: TB-4 (int.) Elevation of Privilege: Grover ~2^64 ops cracks 128-bit KEKs, exposing database DEKs.

g.text: IF-4 Dual-sign ISO 20022 schemas with NIST FIPS 204 (ML-DSA-65) and AES-256 GCM tags.
